name: io.scrapship/scrapship
title: Scrapship.io
description: Read-only facts about Scrapship.io, a free browser space io game: FAQ, leaderboard, live war.

tools.name: about_game
tools.description: What Scrapship.io is, who made it, the price, the platforms and the link to play.

tools.name: how_to_play
tools.description: The controls, how a ship grows, the special blocks, how a match is won and how long it takes.

tools.name: ways_to_play
tools.description: Campaign, ARENA (the free for all, which took in Deathmatch), the war between six sides, and playing with friends, with links.

tools.name: faq
tools.description: The questions and answers from scrapship.io. An optional question filter keeps those whose question or answer contains it.

question.description: Words to look for (not case sensitive).

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: The public pilot leaderboard of scrapship.io/leaderboards: pilot names and their public numbers, sorted and optionally filtered by faction.

sort.description: wins (online wins, the default), kills, ship (biggest ship), sector (furthest sector), level, war (this season's war points) or arena (ARENA wins).

faction.description: Only pilots flying for this side.

limit.description: How many rows (10 by default, 50 at most).

tools.name: war_standings
tools.description: The live war: the season, when it ends, the six sides with the sectors each holds, the leader and the side that needs pilots.

tools.name: play_link
tools.description: The link that opens the game in a browser, free and with no account. With a faction: the link that opens the hall with that side picked, ready to fly for it.

faction.description: A side: settlers, corp, pirates, cult, nomads or merc.
